title: The US Just Recorded Its First 2 Measles Deaths This Year
summary: Amid a 35-year high in US measles cases , two people in Pennsylvania have died after contracting the virus, the state’s health department confirmed on Tuesday. Shapiro cited misinformation around vaccination as a main driver of cases in Pennsylvania.
